facts.text: Tim mentions that watching 'Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone' with his family was a special and magical experience.

evidence.quote: "Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone' is special to me. It was the first movie from the series and brings back some great memories. Watching it with my family was amazing."
Watching that movie with my family was awesome, we'd all get comfy with snacks and a blanket and be totally absorbed. Such a special memory!

facts.text: John expresses that he also loves the first 'Harry Potter' movie and has the entire collection.

evidence.quote: I love that first movie too, I even have the whole collection! It was so magical!
